name: Browserless
tagline: Cloud browser automation for AI agents, with stealth, proxies, and CAPTCHA solving
description: Browserless gives Cline hosted browser automation with stealth features, configurable proxies, and CAPTCHA-solving capabilities. Search the web, scrape and crawl websites, extract structured data, and interact with pages without installing a local browser. A Browserless account is required; a free plan is available.
